infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Duna Pro uses the camera to scan player and ticket codes at check-in and to photograph products and member media.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Duna Pro uses the microphone only when you record a voice note or talk during a live coaching session.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Duna Pro uses the photos you choose for products and member media.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Duna Pro uses your location to connect to in-person payment readers and, when you choose, for a private arrival reminder from 60 minutes before until 30 minutes after a session starts.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Only after you choose a session arrival reminder, Duna Pro keeps your arrival time on the Lock Screen current in the background, during that window only. It stops on its own 30 minutes after the start.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Duna Pro uses Bluetooth to connect to supported card readers for in-person payments.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Duna Pro uses Bluetooth to connect to supported card readers for in-person payments.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Duna Pro uses the local network to find and connect to supported card readers for in-person payments.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Duna Pro reads the calendars you approve on this device so your personal commitments show beside your sessions. It does not add or change events.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Duna Pro reads the calendars you approve on this device so your personal commitments show beside your sessions. It does not add or change events.
